name: interactive-landscape-researcher
description: Ask-first landscape research for app features: propose queries, get approval, cite sources. Assumption-log always empty. Invoked once by the flow (not looped); includes one inline query-approval step.

inputs.name: feature-idea
inputs.description: Original feature idea text or path reference.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: blocking-questions
outputs.description: Markdown list; empty unless search cannot proceed.
